numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.description: Metadata names a kind object and fixes its scope.

name.description: name is required and unique per kind and scope; other kinds reference the object by it.

scope.description: scope is required and not SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED; the loader enforces the latter.
scope.title: Scope

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.title: Metadata

numinance.kinds.v1.Playbook.jsonschema.s.description: Playbook is the procedure for one change type; it shapes grants and never widens them.

extensions.description: extensions holds vendor or customer data under reverse-DNS keys; the Engine never reads it.

metadata.description: metadata is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

spec.description: spec is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.Playbook.jsonschema.s.title: Playbook

numinance.kinds.v1.PlaybookSpec.jsonsche.description: PlaybookSpec holds the steps and the bounds of one change type.

change_type.description: change_type is required: the change type the playbook handles.

max_repair_attempts.description: max_repair_attempts bounds the repair loop, 0 to 10; absent means the default 2.

qualification.description:
qualification is what the playbook must show before autonomy is promoted. Absent means the playbook is not
 promotable unless the AutonomyPolicy floor qualifies it; it merges field by field, and a narrower scope may only tighten it.

steps.description: steps is required and non-empty; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.PlaybookSpec.jsonsche.title: Playbook Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.PlaybookStep.jsonsche.description: PlaybookStep is one step of a playbook. A Change's risk class is the maximum over its steps.

capability_set.description: capability_set is required: the name of the capability set the step's grant is derived from.

evidence.description: evidence names the evidence the step must record; missing declared evidence turns success into PARTIAL.

name.description: name is required and unique in the playbook.

rehearse.description: rehearse is true when the step is rehearsed in a disposable environment first.

risk.description:
risk is required: the step's declared risk class, which only raises; the resolved risk is the maximum of risk and
 the action risk of every RPC the capability set grants.
risk.title: Risk Class

verifiers.description: verifiers names the verifiers that run on the step's output.

numinance.kinds.v1.PlaybookStep.jsonsche.title: Playbook Step

numinance.kinds.v1.Qualification.jsonsch.description:
Qualification is the record a playbook needs before its autonomy is
 promoted. Rates are in basis points, 0 to 10000 (10000 is every run); the
 profile context refuses a larger value. A narrower scope may only tighten a
 threshold: min_runs up, a max rate down, zero_security_escapes never to false; the reference implementation refuses a loosening.

max_regression_rate.description: max_regression_rate is the highest share of runs that caused a regression.

max_rework_rate.description: max_rework_rate is the highest share of runs that needed rework.

max_rollback_rate.description: max_rollback_rate is the highest share of releases rolled back.

min_runs.description: min_runs is the minimum number of qualifying runs; absent means the AutonomyPolicy floor applies.

zero_security_escapes.description:
zero_security_escapes is true when one security escape blocks promotion; absent means true. Only an explicit false
 relaxes it, and a narrower scope may never set false over a wider scope's true or absent value.

numinance.kinds.v1.Qualification.jsonsch.title: Qualification
